practicals.title: Tutorial 1
content: Scope of chemical Industry, Classification of Chemical Industries

practicals.title: Tutorial 2
content: Types / Classification of acids, Physical and chemical properties of
sulphuric acid, Uses of sulphuric acid, Manufacture of sulphuric
acid by DCDA process, Uses and physical properties of HCL
manufacturing process for HNO3, Manufacture of hydrochloric acid
by synthetic method

practicals.title: Tutorial 3
content: Different process of production of soda ash, Manufacturing of soda
ash by Solvay process, Physical properties of soda ash, caustic soda
and chlorine, Production of caustic soda by electrolytic process
Major engineering problems for manufacturing soda ash, caustic
soda and chlorine

practicals.title: Tutorial 4
content: Introduction, Properties of cement, Types of cement, Manufacturing
process of Portland cement, Major Engineering problems of cement
industries, Physical properties of lime, Uses of lime, Manufacturing
process of lime by hydrated lime process, Major Engineering
problems of hydrated lime process

practicals.title: Tutorial 5
content: Introduction, Classification of fuel, Method of production of fuel
gases, producer gas, water gas, coke oven gas, natural gas
Industrial gases Major engineering problems in manufacturing of
different types of gasses

practicals.title: Tutorial 6
content: Introduction, Classification, application of dyes, Azo dyes
Anthroquione dyes, Triamyl dyes, dispersed dyes, Miscellaneous
dyes: azine, thiazines, oxazines, thiazoles, nitro dyes. Various dye
intermediates and their manufacturing, manufacturing of H-acid
Koch acid, Nitro benzene, Chrome blue black

practicals.title: Tutorial 7
content: Introduction, Coking of coal, Distillation of coal tar, Gasification of
coal, Hydrogenation of coal
